failure_modes.name: Limited robustness across repository and task variations
failure_modes.description: The resolved outcomes do not generalize across the heterogeneous benchmark workload, consistent with the system's reported 48.6% overall resolve rate.

why: The system demonstrates meaningful task understanding and can produce successful changes, as shown by two resolved probes, but the 48.6% official resolve rate and two unresolved fixed probes require materially sub-perfect scores. Execution accuracy is weakest because the failures are end-to-end benchmark failures, while the available repository surfaces show substantial tooling and test infrastructure but do not establish consistently reliable completion.
